evals.prompt: I want to plan a business with a website, a product and marketing in this thread. I want detailed plans before anything starts building.
evals.expected_output: One master planning record with separate lanes and recorded dependencies; a short question about an unresolved goal; no build launch or paid agents.

evals.prompt: We already decided it should choose as many workers as my computer can handle, including over ten. Continue planning from that answer.
evals.expected_output: Preserves automatic capacity as settled; distinguishes planner eligibility from runtime admission; asks one new relevant question without reopening the numeric worker count.

evals.prompt: Turn our agreed plan into build tasks: two tasks edit the same config, a website task needs a product API that is not built, and the current runner only understands checklists.
evals.expected_output: Records ownership conflicts and API dependency, checks coverage, produces compatible task checkboxes, and explains unsupported scheduling without claiming the current runner enforces metadata.

evals.prompt: Fix the misspelled Save label in the existing settings button; keep everything else as it is.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger the full master-planning workflow or a broad interview for an already scoped small fix.
